name: Chthonic-Polje
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
